0.4.50.note: Validate every setting the writing hook and check read on the review and publish paths. A gate.json setting of the wrong type or shape, such as publish_tools as a string, a number, a list holding non-strings or null, falls back to its built-in default and the session is told it was ignored. The publish check's error path reads the built-in publish list, cannot raise, and denies any error on a call that list or the configured list names. A malformed ledger threshold or rule weight or min_count falls back to its default and is listed in config_ignored; a rule list, entry, id, scope or registers the check cannot read stops the run as incomplete. Receipts of the wrong shape are skipped.
